summary: Madison Air Solutions Corporation priced its IPO of Class A common stock at $27.00 per share on April 15, 2026. The company sold 82,692,308 shares through underwriters Goldman Sachs, Barclays Capital, Jefferies, and Wells Fargo Securities. The underwriters exercised their option for additional shares on April 16, 2026, and the offering closed on April 17, 2026. The company is listed on NYSE under the ticker MAIR.
